opening.composite: each policy; both ebony references share teacher-v1 exchange only

manifest.pairing: same initial seed, then trajectories and draw recipients may diverge; seed-cluster statistics

summary.uncertainty: 同种子内指定座位、阵容和开局等权平均，再按种子估计标准误及95%正态近似区间。共享初始牌墙不保证动作分歧后各家摸牌相同，也不保证降噪；小样本只作诊断，各开局分层单独解释，不自动判定通过。

scope: Completed old-seed compatibility run only; two seed clusters cannot establish playing strength or formal pass.

replayAudit.mode: Stored-action replay, no policy game replay
replayAudit.derivedCopyExplanation: Only each copied header config.seeds is reduced to that seed; original seed envelope and all selected raw trace lines are preserved. These are explicit audit copies, not new executions or original attempt manifests.

originAudit.scope: Every actual Fanfou decision in the 96 old-seed completed games rechecked against the unchanged adapter; no new full game generated.

validation.originLimitation: Origin metadata was independently recomputed for every Fanfou public node and action matched; original JSONL stores actions only.
